title: Choose the visual world for ClipMac
question: The roll assigned the Triplicate Carbon Form. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Triplicate Carbon Form
options.lineage: NCR carbonless triplicate forms: white, canary, pink copies
options.thesis: Copy is the whole product, so the page is a form that copies itself: whatever is written on the top sheet appears on the sheets beneath.
options.viewport: A full-bleed invoice-style form: ClipMac in oversized stamped type, serial No. 000001 in red, a ballpoint-blue download line, and three offset sheets (white, canary, pink) fanning beneath so the text visibly copies down. A VOID stamp slams across the secret field.
options.risk: Carbon-copy nostalgia reads novelty if the form grid is not strictly governed.

raised.raise: Fixed columns and strict ruled rows: the form grid never moves, only the filled-in entries do.

options.label: Redacted Dossier
options.lineage: declassified FOIA documents with black redaction bars
options.thesis: The secret-hiding feature is the page: a typed memo whose keys and tokens are already blacked out, click to reveal.
options.viewport: A typed memo about ClipMac with redaction bars across the sensitive lines; one bar lifts on hover.
options.risk: Familiar paper-and-ink territory; tilts toward the cream-and-red calibration rut.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Your clipboard as a live departures board: rows ranked by time, expiring at 24h.
options.viewport: A board whose rows flip through recent copies; a secret row flips to bullets.
options.case: Holds product clarity (a list ranked by time); loses on audience, since boards read as transit not Mac.
options.risk: Dark-and-amber is a familiar tech look.

options.label: Memphis Showroom
options.case: Loses both axes: playful but says nothing about copying or privacy.

options.label: ASCII Scene
options.case: Tool monoculture; excludes the any-Mac-user audience.
options.kept: One strict grid as the entire composition.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean Mac-app landing page: headline, app window screenshot, feature grid, download.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and Download button beside a menu-bar app window.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other Mac utility.
